title: Molecular insights on the proangiogenic effects of VEGF like growth factor derived from horseshoe crab perivitelline fluid.
authors: Aghila Rani, K G; Pandit, Hrishikesh; Subedi, Rambhadur; Otiv-Pandit, Sayli; Jogdand, Anil Bankati; Gupta, Hajra; Fandilolu, Prayagraj; Rokade, Sushama; Idicula-Thomas, Susan; Chatterji, Anil; Madan, Taruna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鲎卵周液VEGF样因子的促血管生成作用，仅用分子对接预测其与VEGFR的结合位点，非TF-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The current study investigated the proangiogenic effects of fraction VII of perivitelline fluid (hscPVF-VEGF) obtained from the late-stage embryos of Indian horseshoe crab (Tachypleus gigas; Muller) using human umbilical cord tissue-derived MSCs (hUCMSCs). Angiogenic potential of hscPVF-VEGF was investigated by analyzing transcripts of signature angiogenic markers, key transcription factors and matrix metalloproteases. Molecular docking studies were performed to predict the binding site of hscPVF-VEGF with the VEGF receptor (VEGFR). hscPVF-VEGF significantly upregulated VEGF, vWF, and downregulated sFlt-1. Significant increase in transcriptional levels of HOXA7, HOXB3, HOXB5, CD31, MMP2, and MMP9 further elucidated the molecular mechanism underlying the angiogenic ability of hscPVF-VEGF. Wound healing assay revealed the migratory potential of hscPVF-VEGF. Molecular docking studies predicted that hscPVF-VEGF may modulate hVEGFR activity by binding in a pocket within the extracellular domains (D5, D6, and D7) distal to the VEGF binding site (D2 and D3). This study infers the potential and molecular mechanism of hscPVF-VEGF inducing angiogenic differentiation in hUCMSCs, suggesting clinical application of a recombinant form of hsPVF-VEGF in disorders with dysfunctional angiogenesis.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了从印度鲎（Tachypleus gigas；Muller）晚期胚胎中获取的卵周液组分VII（hscPVF-VEGF）对人脐带组织来源间充质干细胞（hUCMSCs）的促血管生成作用。通过分析特征性血管生成标志物、关键转录因子及基质金属蛋白酶的转录本，研究了hscPVF-VEGF的血管生成潜力。分子对接研究用于预测hscPVF-VEGF与VEGF受体（VEGFR）的结合位点。hscPVF-VEGF显著上调VEGF、vWF，并下调sFlt-1。HOXA7、HOXB3、HOXB5、CD31、MMP2和MMP9转录水平的显著增加进一步阐明了hscPVF-VEGF血管生成能力背后的分子机制。伤口愈合实验揭示了hscPVF-VEGF的迁移潜力。分子对接研究预测，hscPVF-VEGF可能通过结合在远离VEGF结合位点（D2和D3）的胞外域（D5、D6和D7）内的口袋中，调节hVEGFR活性。本研究推断hscPVF-VEGF在诱导hUCMSCs血管生成分化方面的潜力及分子机制，提示重组形式的hsPVF-VEGF在血管生成功能障碍相关疾病中的临床应用前景。
